integrity: The ranking criterion is derived by exact cross-multiplication. A separate standard-library verifier enumerates every protective positive-cell table through the first strict boundary, checks all pairwise comparisons by both rational arithmetic and integer sign formulas, and replays the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: The sharp minimum is for two balanced two-arm binary-outcome tables with the same arm size, positive cells, and direct unadjusted point estimates. It does not cover unequal arm sizes, zero-cell corrections, covariate-adjusted estimands, uncertainty intervals, or meta-analytic weighting.
title: Risk ratio and odds ratio first reverse trial rankings at five patients per arm
